The '''Tertiary Feswe system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
Like the other Feswe systems, the Tertiary Feswe was notable only for being located on the emergency [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]] blazed by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] ahead of the [[Evacuation of Yavin]]. Rebel forces originally intended to [[Hyperspace/Legends|jump]] from the [[Feswe Corridor]] to the Tertiary Feswe system before making their getaway to [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]] and the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. But the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] cut off that route, forcing the Alliance to try to escape past [[Feswe Prime]].<ref name="TEA" />
